prior_summary: Moving-lid SE(3) equivariance: predict each Cartesian TCP target in the currently observed lid body frame, while conditioning on lid-relative geometry and measured robot configuration.
applicable_conditions: Prefer when the observed lid/handle assembly is displaced or rigidly reoriented relative to training, from closed-lid approach through handle contact and opening, provided measured qpos still makes the transformed targets reachable.
termination_guidance: Terminate only from physical observations: fingers open, TCP clear of the panel, lid_position well above closed with low lid_velocity, and peg_pose unchanged. Do not terminate from diffusion time or a closed gripper alone.
limitations: Relative targets do not create reachability, collision avoidance, contact truth or missed-grasp recovery. Fresh moving-lid decoding can couple post-release retreat to lid settling; prefer h03 near nominal placement when release phase is the main uncertainty, or h02 for unusual TCP entry states.
